title: Hedgehog with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#1a3a5c' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- hedgehog body / spiny back -->
  <!-- spines as overlapping rounded triangles -->
  <g>
    <!-- back spines layer -->
    <path d='M22,68 Q18,45 32,35 Q40,28 50,26 Q60,28 68,35 Q82,45 78,68 Z' fill='#8B4513'/>
    <!-- lighter spine tips -->
    <path d='M24,65 L20,42 L30,38 L28,60 Z' fill='#A0522D'/>
    <path d='M32,62 L30,34 L40,30 L38,56 Z' fill='#A0522D'/>
    <path d='M44,60 L44,28 L54,28 L52,54 Z' fill='#A0522D'/>
    <path d='M56,62 L56,30 L66,34 L62,56 Z' fill='#A0522D'/>
    <path d='M68,65 L72,42 L76,48 L70,62 Z' fill='#A0522D'/>
    
    <!-- spine highlights -->
    <path d='M26,60 L24,45 L28,42 L30,58 Z' fill='#CD853F' opacity='0.7'/>
    <path d='M38,56 L37,36 L42,33 L41,52 Z' fill='#CD853F' opacity='0.7'/>
    <path d='M50,54 L50,32 L55,32 L54,50 Z' fill='#CD853F' opacity='0.7'/>
    <path d='M62,56 L63,36 L67,40 L64,53 Z' fill='#CD853F' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- tummy / face area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  
  <!-- lighter tummy patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='46' r='5' fill='#D2691E'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='46' r='5' fill='#D2691E'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' fill='#2F1B14'/>
  <!-- nose highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='65' rx='1.2' ry='0.8' fill='#8B6B5E' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <!-- left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='57' rx='5' ry='5.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- sparkle in left eye -->
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='55' r='2' fill='white'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='58.5' r='1' fill='white' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='59' r='0.6' fill='white' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='57' rx='5' ry='5.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- sparkle in right eye -->
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='55' r='2' fill='white'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='58.5' r='1' fill='white' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='59' r='0.6' fill='white' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45,71 Q50,76 55,71' stroke='#8B6914' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- little legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='80' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#D2691E'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='80' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#D2691E'/>
  
  <!-- tiny toes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='81' r='1.5' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='82' r='1.5' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='81' r='1.5' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='81' r='1.5' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='82' r='1.5' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='81' r='1.5' fill='#A0522D'/>
</svg>
